title: feat(auth): "Sign in with SSO" entry on the login page (PR-2 UI for per-env SSO)
body:
Adds the customer-facing **"Sign in with SSO"** entry to the console login page (`LoginForm`).

On click it routes the entered email to its configured IdP (better-auth's `@better-auth/sso`, by email domain) via `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso` and redirects to the provider's authorization endpoint; shows an inline error when no provider matches the domain. The label is i18n-configurable (`labels.ssoButton`), and the post-login callback is derived from the login path (works under any console base path).

This is the **UI half (PR-2)** of the per-env external-IdP SSO mechanism:
- **Backend (PR-1):** the `@better-auth/sso` integration + adapter field/table bridging — objectstack-ai/framework#2322
- **Design:** ADR-0024 — objectstack-ai/cloud#502

**Verified end-to-end in a real browser** (two federated objectos instances — one OIDC provider, one client): login page → click "Sign in with SSO" → IdP login page → consent → JIT federated session (logged in as the IdP user).
